headline: HBR Realty Buys 83% Stake in Helbor to Pave Way for Delisting
summary: HBR Realty Empreendimentos Imobiliários acquired an 83% stake in developer Helbor following a unified exchange tender offer. The transaction meets conditions required to cancel Helbor's CVM public registration and exit the B3 Novo Mercado.
why: Helbor and HBR Realty are prominent Brazilian real estate developers; delistings remove public liquidity from equity markets.
